description:
A piece of a document version, cut by a versioned parser and chunker.

``chunk_id`` is content-addressed: it excludes ordinal, byte offsets and the document's
content hash, so a chunk whose text did not change keeps its id across revisions and
position shifts. That is what makes "only re-embed what changed" possible.

byte_end.description: End offset in the parsed text, exclusive.
byte_end.title: Byte End

byte_start.description: Start offset in the parsed text (for citations).
byte_start.title: Byte Start

chunker_version.description: Chunker that cut it, e.g. struct-v2.
chunker_version.title: Chunker Version

content_sha256.description: The document version this row was cut from (latest observed on MERGE).
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

created_at.description: When this row was written (UTC, timezone-aware). Freshness is computed from it.
created_at.title: Created At

doc_id.description: The document this chunk belongs to.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

metadata.description: Flat string metadata: heading path, page, language, section type.
metadata.title: Metadata

occurrence.description: Index among chunks of this document with identical text; keeps repeats distinct.
occurrence.title: Occurrence

ordinal.description: Position of the chunk within the document version.
ordinal.title: Ordinal

parser_version.description: Parser that produced the text, e.g. pymupdf-1.24.9.
parser_version.title: Parser Version

schema_version.description: Version of this row's schema. Bumped on any field change; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the row. Every index query and cost report filters on it.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

text.description: The chunk text as it was embedded.
text.title: Text

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of text; the join key for dedup across chunks.
text_sha256.title: Text Sha256

token_count.description: Tokens in text, counted with the embedding tokenizer.
token_count.title: Token Count

title: Chunk
